backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing invoices, payments, user profiles, and role‑based access control with admin/user permissions and data‑management operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with high‑level metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Plain‑text map of frontend file paths to brief functional descriptions for build/reference use.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Deployment checklist covering authentication, admin/user features, UI/UX, data integrity, browser support, limitations, and smoke‑test steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS index file defining base layers, theme variables, and light/dark mode color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML page with a mount point for the React app and script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration with authentication-aware routing, layout, and protected admin/user pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen informing users they lack permission and offering navigation back home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal forcing new users to create a profile with name and role before using the app.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: A layout wrapper that renders navigation based on user identity and role, handles logout, and provides a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Manages a dynamic list of payment mode entries, allowing users to add, edit, and remove individual payment lines.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Provides filter controls for reports, including date ranges, salesman, payment type, and payment mode selection.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payments grouped by retailer with totals, formatting amounts and dates, and showing type and mode labels.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: Renders a paginated, sortable invoices table with ageing calculations and status badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current user's profile and role using the actor, exposing loading states and admin detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity state, login, and logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating invoices, payments, and related data through an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying base styling and color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Displays admin dashboard statistics and navigation cards using report data from backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Provides UI for admins to upload, clear, search, and filter invoice data, integrating file parsing and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login screen that triggers Internet Identity authentication and handles login errors.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Page for editing an existing payment, loading payment details, validating input, and submitting updates.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Page for recording new invoice payments with multiple payment lines, validation, and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a retailer's payment history with formatting helpers and optional admin edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Renders reports with filters, summary stats, ledger table, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine type used for multi-line payment entry forms.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV-like XLSX invoice files, validates required columns, and converts rows into Invoice objects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Generates a CSV report from payment data, including summary and detailed rows, and triggers file download.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Filters invoice lists based on retailer, invoice, and salesman fields.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Parses flexible invoice date formats and computes ageing days relative to today, with a formatter for display.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Converts varied invoice status inputs into a consistent canonical status string.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Computes total, remaining, and excess payment amounts and derives a payment status based on totals.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry lines by checking required fields and ensuring positive amounts per payment mode.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, typography, layout, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing build goals, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features.
